fields.name: Fish Fry
fields.description: A fish fry is a prepared dish of fried fish or a social gathering centered around eating fried fish

fields.name: Chicken Biriyani
fields.description: Chicken biryani is a flavorful mixed rice dish made with tender chicken, fragrant basmati rice, and aromatic spices

fields.name: Donne Briyani
fields.description: Donne biryani is a flavorful, rustic style of rice and meat dish from Karnataka, India, named after the eco-friendly leaf cups ("donne") it is traditionally served in.

fields.name: Mojito
fields.description: A mojito is a traditional Cuban highball made with white rum, fresh lime juice, sugar or simple syrup, fresh mint, and club soda.

fields.name: Bucket Briyani
fields.description: Bucket biryani is a large, shareable portion of traditional layered dum biryani packed and served inside a food-grade plastic bucket

fields.name: Chettinad Chicken Biryani
fields.description: Chettinad biryani is a fiery, aromatic South Indian rice dish from the Chettinad region of Tamil Nadu, known for its bold spices and marinated meat

fields.name: Mushroom Biryani
fields.description: Mushroom biryani is a flavorful vegetarian rice dish made by cooking tender mushrooms and fragrant basmati rice together with aromatic spices, herbs, and onions

fields.name: Vegetable Biryani
fields.description: Veg biryani is a fragrant, mixed-rice dish made with long-grain Basmati Rice, tender mixed vegetables, and warm aromatic spices

fields.name: Hyderabadi Biryani
fields.description: iHyderabadi Chicken Biryani is a world-famous, royal Indian dish celebrated for its distinct aroma, fluffy texture, and rich taste

fields.name: Meen Varuval
fields.description: Meen Varuval is a popular South Indian style spicy pan-fried or shallow-fried fish dish

fields.name: Meen Kuzhambu
fields.description: "Meen" means fish, and "kuzhambu" is a traditional Tamil culinary term for a watery, spiced, and tangy gravy typically based on tamarind

fields.name: Nethili 65
fields.description: Nethili 65 is a crispy, spicy, and deep-fried South Indian appetizer made with fresh anchovy fish

fields.name: Meen Kola Urundai
fields.description: Meen kola urundai is a traditional South Indian, crispy-on-the-outside and soft-on-the-inside deep-fried fish ball appetizer

fields.name: Kari Meen
fields.description: Kari Meen, scientifically known as Etroplus suratensis and commonly called the Pearl Spot fish, is a famous freshwater and brackish water fish native to the backwaters of Kerala, India

fields.name: Mutton Chukka
fields.description: Mutton chukka is a spicy, dry South Indian meat dish made by pan-roasting tender pieces of goat meat with caramelized onions, fresh pepper, and traditional whole spices

fields.name: Chettinad Mutton Biryani
fields.description: Chettinad mutton biryani is a fragrant, spicy South Indian rice dish made with tender mutton, freshly ground spices.

fields.name: Mutton Manchuriyan
fields.description: Mutton Manchurian is a popular Indo-Chinese fusion dish made with tender, fried pieces of goat meat or lamb tossed in a rich, spicy, and tangy umami-packed sauce

fields.name: Mutton Ratha Poriyal
fields.description: Mutton ratha, also known as aattu ratham, is fresh goat or lamb blood that is cooked into a traditional South Indian side dish called ratha poriyal

fields.name: Mutton Kudal Fry
fields.description: Mutton kudal, also known as goat intestine or boti, is an edible organ meat popular in South Indian cuisine with a chewy texture and earthy flavor.

fields.name: Watermelon Mojito
fields.description: Watermelon Mojito: Made using fresh watermelon juice or muddled watermelon chunks combined with lime juice and mint.

fields.name: Mango Mojito
fields.description: Mango Mojito: Blends sweet mango puree or fresh mango juice with tart lemon or lime and mint leaves.

fields.name: Blueberry Mojito
fields.description: Blueberry Mojito: Involves muddling fresh blueberries with simple syrup before adding the mint and citrus base.

fields.name: Strawberry Mojito
fields.description: Strawberry Mojito: Features muddled fresh strawberries or strawberry syrup mixed with lemon-lime notes and fresh mint.

fields.name: Orange Mojito
fields.description: Orange Mojito: Combines fresh orange juice with the standard crisp muddle of mint and lime.

fields.name: Mutton Liver Fry
fields.description: Mutton liver fry is a popular, rich, and spicy South Asian dry dish made by sautéing tender pieces of goat or lamb liver with onions, tomatoes, and aromatic ground spices.

fields.name: Kolkata Briyani
fields.description: Kolkata biryani is a distinct, subtle, and fragrant style of rice and meat dish originating from West Bengal, famous for its signature inclusion of a boiled and fried potato

fields.name: Coconut Mojito
fields.description: A coconut mojito is a creamy, tropical twist on the classic Cuban rum cocktail that blends rich coconut flavor with crisp lime, fresh mint, and fizzy soda water.

fields.name: Apple Mojito
fields.description: A red apple is a sweet, crisp fruit with bright red skin and juicy, pale flesh

fields.name: Grilled Roasted Fish
fields.description: Grilled and roasted fish features a smoky or deep savory char on the outside with flaky, tender, and juicy flesh on the inside

fields.name: Fish Curries
fields.description: A rich, fragrant fish curry features tender fish simmered in a spiced tomato, onion, or coconut-based gravy

fields.name: Mutton Uppu Kari
fields.description: Uppu Kari is a traditional, semi-dry or dry salted meat stir-fry originating from the Chettinad region of Tamil Nadu, India

fields.name: Mutton Pepper Fry
fields.description: Mutton pepper fry is a bold, spicy, and dry South Indian dish made with tender goat meat coated in freshly crushed black pepper, aromatic spices, and curry leaves

fields.name: Apple
fields.description: Apple juice is a sweet, refreshing fruit liquid made by macerating and pressing fresh apples
